instruction.text: What are the clues used to find out what new words mean?

atoms.text: Let’s look at an example. Read and listen to this sentence.
Henry has a big appetite and eats a lot of food for dinner.
The word appetite is probably new, but you can guess that it means to want food because Henry eats a lot of food for dinner.
Now it’s your turn. Use your clues, the underlined words, to find out the meaning of the words in bold.
